'''Dora Altbir''' (born 21 February 1961)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.elmostrador.cl/dia/2019/08/27/dora-altbir-recibe-el-premio-nacional-de-ciencias-exactas-2019/|title=Dora Altbir recibe el Premio Nacional de Ciencias Exactas 2019|last=El Mostrador Cultura|date=2019-08-27|website=El Mostrador|language=es|access-date=2019-10-08}}</ref> is a Chilean physicist in the field of [[nanoscience]] and [[nanotechnology]]. She was awarded the [[National Prize for Exact Sciences (Chile)]] in 2019 for her work in the theoretical study of magnetic [[nanostructure]]s.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mineduc.cl/2019/08/27/dora-altbir-premio-nacional-de-ciencias-exactas-2019/|title=Dora Altbir Drullinsky Premio Nacional de Ciencias Exactas 2019|date=2019-08-27|website=Ministerio de educación|access-date=2019-10-08|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190922203821/https://www.mineduc.cl/2019/08/27/dora-altbir-premio-nacional-de-ciencias-exactas-2019/|archive-date=2019-09-22}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://investigadores.conicyt.cl/es/public_search/researcher?id=9662|title=Dora Rosa Altbir Drullinsky|website=investigadores.conicyt.cl|access-date=2019-10-08}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cnnchile.com/pais/dora-altbir-drullinsky-premio-nacional-de-ciencias-exactas-2019-quien-es_20190827/|title=Doctora en física Dora Altbir Drullinsky recibe el Premio Nacional de Ciencias Exactas 2019|website=CNN Chile|language=es|access-date=2019-10-08}}</ref> She is currently a professor at the [[University of Santiago, Chile]].

Altbir is director of the Center for the Development of Nanoscience and Nanotechnology and director of the ''Dirección de Investigación Científica y Tecnológica'' at the University of Santiago, Chile. She is a corresponding member of the Chilean Academy of Sciences.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.academiadeciencias.cl/dra-altbir-miembro-correspondiente-de-la-academia-recibio-premio-nacional-de-ciencias-exactas/|title=Dra. Dora Altbir, miembro correspondiente de la Academia, recibió Premio Nacional de Ciencias Exactas|language=es|access-date=2019-10-09|date=2019-08-28}}</ref>
